rationale: Cold strict LR KS sources automatically spill buckets omitted from GPU and RAM into unlinked local temporary files. Full-range replay is explicit-only: the source-matched NVMe endpoint is slower than recurrence. GPU/RAM retain priority. Local free-space reserve, real file preallocation and complete numeric/device staging bounds precede construction. Automatic LR limit is at most 64 GiB and a quarter of local free space; explicit zero disables. RAM filesystems and common network filesystems are refused. Setup I/O refusal retains exact Direct; replay I/O failures cannot publish partial matrices.
revisit_condition: Retain source-matched complete E+F, physical/logical I/O and work evidence when changing default spill, filesystem admission, streaming tiles or cost selection. This is ephemeral storage, not cross-geometry or persistent SSD reuse.
